events.title: Update Announcement | Save Compatibility Update (October 15, 2026)
events.summary: ———————— Important Save Notice ————————The full release differs significantly from the demo, making older demo saves incompatible.This update revises the save system so demo saves can carry over to the full release.Older demo saves will no longer work after this update. The tutorial will restart, and items must be unlocked again.Saves created in the updated demo will be compatible with the future full release.———————— New Additions ————————Added 4 guns: Eternal Frostfire, Hydro Cannon, Blast Pie
